description: Reified 'Creation' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Creator.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work creation activity to an actor responsible for carrying it out.

Creation Event Location.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work creation activity to a location at which it was carried out.

Creation Event Technique.description: This field is used to indicate a kind of technique used in the execution of the documented entity creation activity.

Creation Event Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the documented textual work creation activity.

Creation Event Source Reference.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work creation activity to a textual source which documents the creation itself.

Date of Creation Event.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work creation activity to an instance of time-span recording the temporal extent of the activity.
